boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 125 is a fast U-frame board where a bottom launcher row feeds blocks upward into a U-shaped gap. The side arms must thin to the blue `6` and `4` tiles before the launchers can fire — otherwise the gap overflows. Break those counters, then spend the launcher row for a PERFECT clear. The white `9` counter on the center green block is the last launch trigger.
landmarks: Block Out Level 125 is a fast U-frame board where a bottom launcher row feeds blocks upward into a U-shaped gap.
The side arms must thin to the blue `6` and `4` tiles before the launchers can fire — otherwise the gap overflows.
Break those counters, then spend the launcher row for a PERFECT clear.
The white `9` counter on the center green block is the last launch trigger.

quickTips: Break the blue `6` counter before the blue `4` counter to keep the yellow base pair open.
Do not touch the center red `17` launcher until both side counter tiles are gone.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Shift the left-arm yellow/green/red stack downward with the far-left green up-arrow without touching the blue `6` tile.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Mirror the right-arm orange/red/blue stack with the far-right green up-arrow, keeping the blue `4` counter parked.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the blue `6` counter tile on the left arm once both side stacks are three blocks tall.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Break the blue `4` counter tile on the right arm before the two yellow base bricks move.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom launcher row — left red `25`, center red `17`, right green `25` — to feed the remaining blocks into the U gap.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom `9` counter tile and the last red/blue scraps through the center green arrow for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Breaking the blue `4` counter before the blue `6` — this jams the yellow base pair permanently.
Shifting the center red `17` launcher before both side counter tiles clear, boxing both arms.
